fdinewinvestmentdescription1: New investments in Vietnam are a crucial first step for foreign investors seeking to establish businesses and implement business projects. This process requires compliance with various legal regulations relating to business sectors, market access conditions for foreign investors, project location, investment capital, and licensing procedures.
fdinewinvestmentdescription2: Phuc Gia Uy & Associates Law Firm (PGU) provides comprehensive legal consulting services for foreign investors undertaking new investment projects in Vietnam. We support clients from the pre-feasibility study stage, investment model selection, application for Investment Registration Certificates (IRC), establishment of foreign-invested enterprises, to the necessary legal procedures for project operation.
fdinewinvestmentdescription3: With extensive experience in foreign direct investment (FDI) matters, PGU is committed to providing effective legal solutions, efficient procedures, and cost-effective services, enabling investors to implement their projects smoothly and in full compliance with Vietnamese law.

fdiamendircnamesection: Amendments to the Investment Registration Certificate
fdiamendircdescription1: Amending the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) is a legal procedure that needs to be carried out when an investor makes adjustments related to the project's objectives, investment scale, implementation location, investment capital, capital contribution schedule, investors, or other important aspects of the project. Proper and timely implementation of this adjustment procedure ensures that the project operates in accordance with legal regulations and the content approved by the state authorities.
fdiamendircdescription2: Phuc Gia Uy & Associates Law Firm (PGU) provides legal advisory and procedural services for the amendment of Investment Registration Certificates for foreign investors in Vietnam. We assist in assessing legal conditions, preparing documents, working with investment registration authorities, and monitoring the entire process until the amendment is completed.
fdiamendircdescription3: With extensive practical experience in foreign direct investment (FDI) matters, PGU helps investors complete procedures quickly and in accordance with regulations, minimizing legal risks and ensuring that projects are adjusted and continue to be implemented smoothly.

fdiprojectreportdescription1: Project reporting is a mandatory legal obligation of investors during the implementation of investment projects in Vietnam. In accordance with applicable regulations, foreign-invested enterprises (FIEs) are required to submit periodic reports on project implementation, investment capital, labor, revenue, and other relevant information via the investment reporting system or directly to competent state authorities.
fdiprojectreportdescription2: Phuc Gia Uy & Associates Law Firm (PGU) provides advisory and implementation services for project reporting obligations for foreign-invested enterprises, including reviewing reporting obligations, preparing report content, submitting reports through the reporting system, and assisting in resolving issues with regulatory authorities.
fdiprojectreportdescription3: With extensive experience in foreign direct investment (FDI), PGU assists enterprises in fulfilling reporting obligations accurately, timely, and in compliance with regulations, thereby minimizing the risk of administrative violations and ensuring the stable operation of their projects.

businessterminationdescription1: During the course of their operations, for various reasons such as changes in business strategy, restructuring, or financial difficulties, enterprises and household businesses may decide to terminate their operations. Such termination must be carried out in accordance with applicable laws and regulations to ensure the fulfillment of tax and financial obligations and to mitigate potential legal risks.
businessterminationdescription2: The procedure for ceasing business operations typically includes steps such as notifying the business registration authority, fulfilling tax obligations, liquidating assets, and handling related liabilities. If not done correctly, enterprises may face difficulties in closing their tax registration number or incur administrative penalties.
businessterminationdescription3: Phuc Gia Uy Law Firm provides comprehensive consulting and support services for business termination, ensuring that all procedures are completed efficiently, smoothly, and in full compliance with applicable regulations.
